preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) >= 1 and all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix is non-empty and rectangular (all rows have the same length).

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the matrix contains exactly one lowercase alphabetical character.
The dimensions n and m are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum(1 for path in all_valid_paths(matrix) if is_palindrome(path)) % 1000000007)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all valid paths from top-left to bottom-right (moving only right or down) that form a palindromic string, modulo 10^9 + 7.
